newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Forecast Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds/Bonos.
newsitem.headline: Forecast Portuguese bond spreads vs Bunds/Bonos.

text.p: The following is a daily forecast of yield spreads of Portuguese fixed rate bonds (OTs) against Bonos and Bunds.
Spread Feb 2007 OTs vs Jul 2007 Bund 63/65.4/67 vs 66 bp
Feb 2007 OTs vs Mar 2007 Bono -4/-7.6/-10 vs -6 bp
Feb 2007 OTs vs Mar 1999 OTs 122/124.2/126 vs 124 bp
Jun 97 future BPDOTM7 (0758 GMT) -0.17 points to 109.20
Main factors that could influence trade:
Ten-year Portuguese bonds expected to show some
volatility with spreads against Bunds oscillating around 65 basis points. Focus seen on Spanish five-year bond auction. Shorter bonds expected to be well-supported.
